strategy_label: Volatility-adjusted Donchian Channel breakout (Turtle Trading System Two, N=55/M=20/ATR=20)

source.license: No LICENSE file found in the repository at retrieval time -> LICENSE_UNKNOWN -> CODE_REUSE_ALLOWED=FALSE for this mission; rule extraction from the public README only, no code imported or executed.
source.underlying_system: Turtle Trading System Two (Dennis & Eckhardt, 1983); theoretical grounding also cites Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012) 'Time Series Momentum' and Baltas & Kosowski (2013).
source.original_venue: 8 liquid FUTURES instruments (CL, GC, 6E, SI, 6J, ES, ZN and one more), NOT crypto and NOT CFD.

rule_extracted: Entry: flat position opens LONG if today's close > max close of prior N=55 days; SHORT if close < min close of prior N=55 days. Exit: while long, close if close < min close of prior M=20 days; while short, close if close > max close of prior M=20 days (M<N by design). Position size inversely scaled to ATR(20); leverage capped at 5x. All decision inputs use data up to t-1 (explicit no-look-ahead design in the source's own README). Parameters are the fixed, published Turtle System Two values -- the source author explicitly states no tuning was performed against their own data.
source_backtest_class: SB5_OOS_OR_WALK_FORWARD (source reports explicit in-sample vs out-of-sample Sharpe/return comparison per instrument and for the combined 8-instrument portfolio, e.g. combined portfolio Sharpe 0.531 in-sample -> 0.209 out-of-sample).

G1_CONTRACTABLE.reason: Fully deterministic, exact N/M/ATR parameters, exact entry/exit/position-sizing formulas, explicit no-look-ahead design.

G2_TICKETABLE.reason: This is a continuously-held trend-following position with an exit rule based on a rolling M-day extreme, not a discrete entry with a single fixed TP. It fails this mission's ticketability gate (AG's informational-ticket workflow needs a discrete entry + fixed SL + TP1/TP2) unless deterministically translated into a new derived ticket-style candidate (e.g. ATR-based initial stop + fixed R target substituted for the rolling-exit rule) -- which this mission does NOT do, per the instruction not to silently rewrite a candidate.

G3_DATA_VENUE_FIT.reason: No BTC or ETH OHLC price history of any kind is physically present in this repository checkout (see data_capability_matrix.json) -- only a single point-in-time VT Markets symbol-metadata snapshot. Separately, the source instruments are FUTURES, not spot or CFD; VT Markets BTCUSD/ETHUSD are CFDs with an overnight SWAP, not futures margining -- an explicit venue translation (contract size, leverage mechanics, overnight cost) would be required even if data existed. Neither gap is resolved in R1.

G4_CAUSALITY_WARMUP.reason: Source README explicitly states all decision inputs use data up to t-1; per the EXTERNAL CODE RULE this mission does not execute the source repository's code to independently re-verify, only reads and records the stated design.

G5_TRANSLATION_FIDELITY.reason: No replay was attempted (blocked at G2/G3), so no translated rule set exists yet to classify EXACT/SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT/MATERIAL_DEVIATION against.

verdict_reason: Blocked at the data/venue-fit gate: this environment has zero historical OHLC bars for BTCUSD/ETHUSD, so no DEV replay is possible regardless of how well-specified the source rule is. Independently, the rule as literally sourced also fails ticketability (G2) and would require a deliberate, explicitly-labeled derived-candidate translation before any replay could even be meaningful. Both gaps are recorded rather than silently resolved.
